method: Regex screen of every executed block (training, fitting, matrix products, argmax), then manual reading of every flagged block and every block that saved an edit.
line_drawn: Allowed: statistics of weights, recorded activations and recorded outputs, including mean-level attribution weight x mean activation. Not allowed: item-level outputs or scores of modified weights computed in Python, and solving or regressing for weight values.
consequence: independent/gemini is excluded from portfolio selection in the primary (valid-only) analysis; the as-run analysis is reported alongside. This exclusion rule was decided after the run and is disclosed as such.

peers/openai.notes: Mean-level attribution (weight x mean activation) to rank fc connections; every candidate tested through the forward tool. A forward block carried a leaked 'to=all' marker; harmless.

peers/anthropic.notes: Attribution on recorded activations; argmax only on recorded forward-tool outputs.

peers/gemini.notes: Reports 'mean logit drop' = summed weight x mean activation of removed/boosted connections for one class: mean-level linear attribution, the same quantity other editors used and the published recipe's own rebalancing step. No item-level predictions or accuracy for modified weights; 7 candidates tested through the forward tool.

independent/openai.notes: Attribution only; froze candidate before its own holdout. Tiny edit (24 entries).

independent/anthropic.notes: Attribution only; froze candidate before its own holdout.

independent/gemini.notes: VIOLATION. (1) eval_zero_bias_loo (records 12-17, 19) computes the logit shift dw.h of candidate weight changes on individual recorded avgpool activations with leave-one-out: an offline evaluator of modified fc weights, which the prompt forbids. (2) The submitted edit (record 20) solves a 2x2 linear system per class for the weight change that hits target logit shifts (+0.3 clean, -3.8 spurious): fitting weights to targets, also forbidden. Stopped at its spending guard after 2 of 8 passes.
